description: Compare up to 10 weather forecast models head-to-head across lead days 0 to 7 on global historical error curves (including circular angular error and >3 m/s active-wind curves for wind_direction), plus optional local H3 cell (lat/lon) matched-cohort or country cell-win comparisons, with explicit cohort and station-commissioned (mLM) caveats. All 45 FACT models (2025 archive, 2025-02-13 to 2025-12-31, QoD >= 0.80 station-days): WeatherXM MOSAIC (MOSAIC), meteoblue (METEOBLUE), meteoblue station-mLM (commissioned) (mLM), ECMWF IFS (IFS025, IFSHRES), ECMWF AIFS AI (AIFS025), NOAA GFS 0.5° (GFS05), NOAA HRRR (HRRR), NOAA National Blend of Models (NBM), NOAA NAM (NAM3, NAM5, NAM12, NAMAK), DWD ICON (ICON, ICONEU, ICOND2), UK Met Office (UMGLOBAL10, UKMO2), ECCC GEM (GEM15, GEM2), Meteo-France ARPEGE/AROME (MFGLOBAL, MFEU, MFFR), COSMO (COSMOI2, COSMOM5), HARMONIE-AROME (HARMONIE), JMA MSM (MSM), WRF (WRFGR, WRFAMS), meteoblue NEMS/NMM (NEMSGLOBAL, NEMSGLOBAL_E, NEMS4, NEMS12, NEMS12_E, NEMSAF01, NEMSAS02, NEMSCAM, NEMSIN, NEMSNZ, NEMSSA, NMM4, NMM22), regional models (AF01, AS01, SA01). GFS025 is not archived; requests for it resolve to GFS05 with a resolution warning.
name: get_model_head_to_head
